payload.prompt: Hemos recibido la factura INV-2026-1625 del proveedor Viento SL (org. nº 822028365) por 21300 NOK con IVA incluido. El importe corresponde a servicios de oficina (cuenta 7140). Registre la factura del proveedor con el IVA soportado correcto (25 %).

payload.goal: Registrar la factura de proveedor INV-2026-1625 de Viento SL por 21300 NOK (IVA incluido al 25%) imputada a la cuenta 7140 (servicios de oficina).
success_checks: El proveedor Viento SL (org. nº 822028365) existe en el sistema
La factura INV-2026-1625 queda registrada con importe total 21300 NOK
El importe neto calculado es 17040 NOK y el IVA soportado es 4260 NOK (25%)
La línea de gasto está imputada a la cuenta 7140
El IVA soportado queda registrado en la cuenta de IVA correspondiente
El estado de la factura es 'aprobada/pendiente de pago' en Tripletex
risk_notes: No se indica la fecha de la factura ni la fecha de vencimiento; se deberán solicitar o usar la fecha actual como fallback
No se indica la moneda; se asume NOK por defecto
El importe 21300 NOK incluye IVA al 25%: neto = 21300 / 1.25 = 17040 NOK, IVA = 4260 NOK
Verificar que la cuenta 7140 existe en el plan contable del sandbox; si no, crearla antes de registrar
Verificar que el módulo de facturas de proveedor está habilitado en Tripletex
No se adjunta PDF de la factura; puede ser requerido según configuración del sistema
payload.suggested_first_action: Buscar o crear el proveedor Viento SL con org. nº 822028365 mediante POST /supplier si no existe.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /supplier?organizationNumber=822028365 — verificar si Viento SL ya existe
2. Si no existe: POST /supplier con name='Viento SL', organizationNumber='822028365'
3. Verificar que la cuenta 7140 existe: GET /ledger/account?query=7140
4. Calcular importes: total=21300 NOK, neto=17040 NOK, IVA=4260 NOK (25%)
5. POST /supplierInvoice — crear factura de proveedor con: invoiceNumber='INV-2026-1625', supplier.id=<id>, amountIncludingVat=21300, currency='NOK'
6. Añadir línea de asiento: cuenta 7140, importe neto 17040 NOK, IVA 25% (4260 NOK)
7. Verificar que el asiento contable refleja: débito cuenta 7140 (17040), débito cuenta IVA soportado (4260), crédito cuenta de proveedor (21300)
8. Aprobar/confirmar la factura de proveedor en Tripletex: PUT /supplierInvoice/{id}/:approve
9. Verificar estado final de la factura mediante GET /supplierInvoice/{id}

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
FORBIDDEN: /supplierInvoice is not available in sandbox.
Use POST /ledger/voucher with supplier reference instead. See register_supplier_invoice playbook.

what_went_wrong: Used POST /ledger/voucher instead of POST /supplierInvoice — the task requires registering a supplier invoice, not a manual voucher, causing all 6 scoring checks to fail.
Multiple failed attempts with vatType auto-split (ids 1, 3, 12) wasted 4 API calls with 422 errors before falling back to manual postings with vatType=0.
Final voucher used vatType=0 on all postings, meaning no VAT type was recorded — even if the endpoint were correct, VAT reporting would be wrong.
The agent never attempted POST /supplierInvoice despite the planner explicitly listing it as step 5 in the plan.
what_worked: Correctly calculated net (17,040) and VAT (4,260) amounts from gross 21,300 NOK at 25%.
Successfully resolved account IDs for 7140, 2710, and 2400 via GET /ledger/account.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice with invoiceNumber='INV-2026-1625', supplierId=108484429, amountIncludingVatCurrency=21300, currency='NOK', and orderLines referencing account 7140 with vatType 25%.
For supplier invoices, use the dedicated /supplierInvoice endpoint which handles VAT automatically — avoid /ledger/voucher for structured AP transactions.
If /supplierInvoice requires order lines, set amountExcludingVat=17040, vatAmount=4260, vatPercent=25 on the line item pointing to account 7140.
